note: Free (LGPL) AT/386 firmware — the vendored, redistributable ROMs that let the experimental fully-free 80386 AT machine POST, boot, and run FreeDOS in the browser with NO proprietary IBM 5170 ROM. Both binaries are third-party LGPL firmware (the Bochs legacy BIOS and the LGPL VGABios), shipped UNMODIFIED. They are vendored here from bw-board's roms/free-at-bios/ at the pinned sha (bwBoardPin), which is itself an unmodified copy of the upstreams below. lite's debug-runner (attachI80386) loads bios at 0xF0000 + the 386 high alias 0xFF0000 and vgabios at 0xC0000. These REPLACE the copyrighted IBM AT ROM, which stays an optional maintainer-only fidelity oracle ($AT_BIOS_ROM, never committed).
upstreamOf: vendored from bw-board roms/free-at-bios (unmodified upstream firmware)
